posts.text: Despite being the father of Rock’n’Roll, a musical icon, and selling millions and million of records, he only ever had one #1 song on the Billboard Hot 100. Which blows my mind.  In other news, Senator Lindsey Graham passed away.  #senator #lindseygraham #illness
